title: A Godly Man's Leadership Is Paid For, Not Given
caption:
A godly man leads by going in first. Authority earned, never just handed to him.

Take the ugliest job on the list before you delegate it. Apologize before anyone makes you. Absorb the cost before it reaches the men you lead. Stay after the credit's gone.

That's the math nobody tells you about leadership: you pay first, and that's exactly why they follow.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
